caption: The drawing depicts a single animal resembling a goat or antelope, positioned in a standing pose on a rectangular, flat base that simulates rough ground. The animal is shown in profile with its head turned slightly to the left. It has two slightly curved, ridged horns on its head, and its fur is rendered in shades of brown with detailed texturing to indicate the direction of hair growth. The animal has a short tail, upright ears, and is depicted with all four legs visible, with the right hind leg lifted as if taking a step. The eyes are yellowish with a visible dark pupil. The base of the sculpture is a dull brown, matching the earthy tone of the animal. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decoration.
title: Cast Iron Goat
